## Problem and approach

Explain the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue when applicable (`Closes #123` only when this PR fully resolves it).

## Validation

List relevant tests and results. Include screenshots for UI changes or migration/recovery evidence for data changes. State any untested behavior or remaining limitation.

## Risks and follow-up

Note compatibility, security or operational consequences when relevant. Isolated fixtures are allowed; production catalog/listing authenticity, user ownership and immediate search guarantees must remain intact.
